events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway activation on Century 21 NYC's main floor where anyone can walk the runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: No ticket or invitation is required. Each walker receives a free Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches, and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21's official event page says there is no ticket, invitation or registration. Walking the runway means being filmed for Century 21 Instagram and TikTok stories. Totes and patches are while supplies last; the discount card requires a $100 in-store purchase to redeem.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 from 12–6 PM on the main floor, Dey Street side. Enter on Dey Street and follow the runway setup.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats, photo moments and shade discovery.
events.what_is_free: Public access is free. Current listings advertise free Dewy Lip Shine sampling and sweet treats; a NYLON promotional email says the first 50 guests receive a jelly bag with the full Dewy Lip Shine collection, while supplies last.
events.caveats: NYC for FREE and Average Socialite independently list the event as open to the public on September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway. Product, treats and the first-50 full-collection bags are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. No RSVP, approval or paid ticket requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A large public beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza built around Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with touch-ups, product giveaways and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free and open to the public. Current listings advertise free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skin-care products; City Guide reports 10,000 products will be given away.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC event sources agree that the event is free and open to the public on September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Giveaway inventory is finite and should be treated as while supplies last rather than guaranteed to every attendee.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. No advance RSVP, organizer approval or paid ticket requirement is published in the verified current listings.
